name: Fuel pump
role: Delivers pressurized fuel from the tank to the rails. Watch its pulse: each beat feeds the next injection.

name: Fuel rail L
role: Distributes fuel to the three left-bank injectors at steady pressure.

name: Fuel rail R
role: Distributes fuel to the three right-bank injectors at steady pressure.

name: Fuel injector 1
role: Sprays a metered fuel pulse into cylinder 1 during its intake stroke.

name: Fuel injector 2
role: Sprays a metered fuel pulse into cylinder 2 during its intake stroke.

name: Fuel injector 3
role: Sprays a metered fuel pulse into cylinder 3 during its intake stroke.

name: Fuel injector 4
role: Sprays a metered fuel pulse into cylinder 4 during its intake stroke.

name: Fuel injector 5
role: Sprays a metered fuel pulse into cylinder 5 during its intake stroke.

name: Fuel injector 6
role: Sprays a metered fuel pulse into cylinder 6 during its intake stroke.

name: Piston 1
role: Left-bank piston, front. Draws in mixture on intake, compresses, takes the power stroke.

name: Piston 2
role: Left-bank piston, middle.

name: Piston 3
role: Left-bank piston, rear.

name: Piston 4
role: Right-bank piston, front.

name: Piston 5
role: Right-bank piston, middle.

name: Piston 6
role: Right-bank piston, rear.

name: Connecting rods
role: Link each piston to the crankshaft, turning reciprocation into rotation.

name: Crankshaft
role: Collects all six power strokes into one rotation. Firing order 1-4-2-5-3-6.

name: Flywheel
role: Smooths rotation between power strokes at the rear of the crank.

name: Camshaft L
role: Opens the left-bank valves at half crank speed.

name: Camshaft R
role: Opens the right-bank valves at half crank speed.

name: Spark plugs
role: One per cylinder; fires each mixture charge at the end of compression.

name: Intake manifold
role: Feeds air to all six intake ports from the valley between banks.

name: Cylinder bank L
role: Left cylinder bank: three bores at 30 degrees off vertical.

name: Cylinder bank R
role: Right cylinder bank: three bores at 30 degrees off vertical.

name: Crankcase
role: Structural core carrying the crankshaft and both banks.

name: Oil pan
role: Oil reservoir bolted under the crankcase.
